def equation(t, P, params):

    num = (params[0] + params[1]*t + params[2]*np.sin(w*t) + params[3]*np.cos(w*t)
           + params[4]*np.sin(2*w*t) + params[5]*np.cos(2*w*t) + params[6]*t**2)
